speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs (a) which agency has jurisdiction over the operating hours of 24-hour amusement centres; (b) what is the basis in allowing them to run a 24-hour operation; (c) whether the Ministry is aware that such centres attract undesirable 	Page: 27 behaviour, especially with alcohol drinking on the premises; (d) how many centres have lost their licences because of Police action over the past three years; (e) how many centres are there currently and how many of them are in the heartlands; and (f) whether there will be restrictions on the setting up of such centres in the interest of public safety.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: I have several such computer games centres near Jalan Pelatina.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: I understood that the licence is issued under the Registry of Societies (ROS).

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Residents have been asking for the removal of such centres because they cause a lot of noise, people drink and create a lot of disamenity to the residents in that area.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The Member is asking about specific examples for specific situations.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
